name: approval_progress
definition:
SELECT v.approval_id,
    v.required,
    v.provided,
    v.outstanding,
    v.next_needed,
    v.next_owed_by,
    v.last_sent_on,
    p.office_id
   FROM ( SELECT a.id AS approval_id,
            count(r.id) AS required,
            count(r.id) FILTER (WHERE r.provided) AS provided,
            count(r.id) FILTER (WHERE NOT r.provided) AS outstanding,
            ( SELECT r2.title
                   FROM approval_requirements r2
                  WHERE r2.approval_id = a.id AND NOT r2.provided
                  ORDER BY r2."position"
                 LIMIT 1) AS next_needed,
            ( SELECT r2.owed_by
                   FROM approval_requirements r2
                  WHERE r2.approval_id = a.id AND NOT r2.provided
                  ORDER BY r2."position"
                 LIMIT 1) AS next_owed_by,
            max(r.provided_on) FILTER (WHERE r.provided) AS last_sent_on
           FROM approvals a
             LEFT JOIN approval_requirements r ON r.approval_id = a.id
          GROUP BY a.id) v
     LEFT JOIN approvals p ON p.id = v.approval_id;

name: approval_watch
definition:
SELECT v.id,
    v.title,
    v.kind,
    v.status,
    v.authority,
    v.reference,
    v.product_id,
    v.warehouse_id,
    v.client_id,
    v.handled_by,
    v.submitted_on,
    v.decided_on,
    v.issued_on,
    v.expires_on,
    v.cost,
    v.next_action,
    v.notes,
    v.created_at,
    v.product_name,
    v.warehouse_name,
    v.client_name,
    v.days_to_expiry,
    v.has_expired,
    v.expiring_soon,
    v.days_since_submitted,
    v.needs_attention,
    v.required,
    v.provided,
    v.outstanding,
    v.next_needed,
    v.next_owed_by,
    v.last_sent_on,
    p.office_id
   FROM ( SELECT a.id,
            a.title,
            a.kind,
            a.status,
            a.authority,
            a.reference,
            a.product_id,
            a.warehouse_id,
            a.client_id,
            a.handled_by,
            a.submitted_on,
            a.decided_on,
            a.issued_on,
            a.expires_on,
            a.cost,
            a.next_action,
            a.notes,
            a.created_at,
            p_1.name AS product_name,
            w.name AS warehouse_name,
            c.name AS client_name,
                CASE
                    WHEN a.expires_on IS NULL THEN NULL::integer
                    ELSE a.expires_on - CURRENT_DATE
                END AS days_to_expiry,
            a.expires_on IS NOT NULL AND a.expires_on < CURRENT_DATE AS has_expired,
            a.expires_on IS NOT NULL AND a.expires_on >= CURRENT_DATE AND a.expires_on <= (CURRENT_DATE + 60) AS expiring_soon,
                CASE
                    WHEN a.submitted_on IS NULL THEN NULL::integer
                    ELSE CURRENT_DATE - a.submitted_on
                END AS days_since_submitted,
            (a.status = ANY (ARRAY['not_started'::approval_status, 'preparing'::approval_status, 'submitted'::approval_status, 'in_review'::approval_status, 'rejected'::approval_status])) OR a.expires_on IS NOT NULL AND a.expires_on <= (CURRENT_DATE + 60) AS needs_attention,
            g.required,
            g.provided,
            g.outstanding,
            g.next_needed,
            g.next_owed_by,
            g.last_sent_on
           FROM approvals a
             LEFT JOIN products p_1 ON p_1.id = a.product_id
             LEFT JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = a.warehouse_id
             LEFT JOIN clients c ON c.id = a.client_id
             LEFT JOIN approval_progress g ON g.approval_id = a.id) v
     LEFT JOIN approvals p ON p.id = v.id;

name: cash_position
definition:
SELECT v.bank_account_id,
    v.name,
    v.bank,
    v.currency,
    v.opening_balance,
    v.opening_date,
    v.received,
    v.spent,
    v.wages_and_drawings,
    v.balance,
    p.office_id
   FROM ( SELECT b.id AS bank_account_id,
            b.name,
            b.bank,
            b.currency,
            b.opening_balance,
            b.opening_date,
            COALESCE(r.amt, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(c.amt, 0::numeric) AS received,
            COALESCE(e.amt, 0::numeric) AS spent,
            COALESCE(w.amt, 0::numeric) AS wages_and_drawings,
            b.opening_balance + COALESCE(r.amt, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(c.amt, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(e.amt, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(w.amt, 0::numeric) AS balance
           FROM bank_accounts b
             LEFT JOIN ( SELECT invoice_payments.bank_account_id,
                    sum(invoice_payments.amount) AS amt
                   FROM invoice_payments
                  WHERE invoice_payments.bank_account_id IS NOT NULL
                  GROUP BY invoice_payments.bank_account_id) r ON r.bank_account_id = b.id
             LEFT JOIN ( SELECT expenses.bank_account_id,
                    sum(expenses.amount_aed) AS amt
                   FROM expenses
                  WHERE expenses.bank_account_id IS NOT NULL AND expenses.paid_on IS NOT NULL AND expenses.kind = 'contribution'::expense_kind
                  GROUP BY expenses.bank_account_id) c ON c.bank_account_id = b.id
             LEFT JOIN ( SELECT expenses.bank_account_id,
                    sum(expenses.amount_aed) AS amt
                   FROM expenses
                  WHERE expenses.bank_account_id IS NOT NULL AND expenses.paid_on IS NOT NULL AND expenses.kind = 'expense'::expense_kind
                  GROUP BY expenses.bank_account_id) e ON e.bank_account_id = b.id
             LEFT JOIN ( SELECT payroll.bank_account_id,
                    sum(payroll.amount) AS amt
                   FROM payroll
                  WHERE payroll.bank_account_id IS NOT NULL AND payroll.paid_on IS NOT NULL
                  GROUP BY payroll.bank_account_id) w ON w.bank_account_id = b.id
          WHERE b.is_active) v
     LEFT JOIN bank_accounts p ON p.id = v.bank_account_id;

name: catalogue_pricing
definition:
WITH cfg AS (
         SELECT max(settings.value::numeric) FILTER (WHERE settings.key = 'supply_discount'::text) AS supply_discount,
            max(settings.value::numeric) FILTER (WHERE settings.key = 'install_rate_aed'::text) AS install_rate,
            max(settings.value::numeric) FILTER (WHERE settings.key = 'default_margin'::text) AS margin,
            max(settings.value::numeric) FILTER (WHERE settings.key = 'eur_aed_rate'::text) AS fx
           FROM settings
        ), cov AS (
         SELECT products.id,
                CASE products.coverage_unit
                    WHEN 'kg/m2'::text THEN products.coverage_max
                    WHEN 'g/m2'::text THEN products.coverage_max / 1000.0
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS kg_m2
           FROM products
        )
 SELECT p.id AS product_id,
    p.name,
    p.category,
    p.subcategory,
    p.consumption_text,
    v.kg_m2 AS kg_per_m2,
    k.id AS pack_id,
    k.label AS pack,
    k.pack_qty,
    k.unit,
    k.eur_total AS rrp_eur,
    k.eur_per_unit AS rrp_eur_per_unit,
    round(k.eur_total * (1::numeric - c.supply_discount), 2) AS cost_eur,
    round(k.eur_per_unit * (1::numeric - c.supply_discount), 4) AS cost_eur_per_unit,
    round(k.eur_total * (1::numeric - c.supply_discount) * c.fx, 2) AS cost_aed,
    round(k.eur_per_unit * (1::numeric - c.supply_discount) * c.fx * v.kg_m2, 2) AS material_cost_aed_m2,
    round(k.eur_per_unit * (1::numeric - c.supply_discount) * c.fx * v.kg_m2 + c.install_rate, 2) AS total_cost_aed_m2,
    round(k.eur_per_unit * (1::numeric - c.supply_discount) * c.fx * v.kg_m2 / NULLIF(1::numeric - c.margin, 0::numeric) + c.install_rate, 2) AS sell_aed_m2,
    c.supply_discount,
    c.install_rate,
    c.margin,
    c.fx
   FROM products p
     JOIN product_packs k ON k.product_id = p.id
     JOIN cov v ON v.id = p.id
     CROSS JOIN cfg c
  WHERE p.is_active AND NOT k.is_poa AND k.eur_per_unit IS NOT NULL;

name: commitment_totals
definition:
SELECT v.commitment_id,
    v.reference,
    v.supplier,
    v.title,
    v.category,
    v.status,
    v.quoted_on,
    v.valid_until,
    v.currency,
    v.header_amount,
    v.amount_aed,
    v.lines_total,
    v.line_count,
    v.estimated_lines,
    v.difference,
    v.lines_agree,
    v.documents,
    p.office_id
   FROM ( SELECT c.id AS commitment_id,
            c.reference,
            c.supplier,
            c.title,
            c.category,
            c.status,
            c.quoted_on,
            c.valid_until,
            c.currency,
            c.amount AS header_amount,
            c.amount_aed,
            COALESCE(l.total, 0::numeric) AS lines_total,
            COALESCE(l.n, 0::bigint) AS line_count,
            COALESCE(l.estimates, 0::bigint) AS estimated_lines,
            round(c.amount - COALESCE(l.total, 0::numeric), 2) AS difference,
                CASE
                    WHEN abs(c.amount - COALESCE(l.total, 0::numeric)) < 0.01 THEN true
                    ELSE false
                END AS lines_agree,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM commitment_documents d
                  WHERE d.commitment_id = c.id) AS documents
           FROM commitments c
             LEFT JOIN ( SELECT commitment_lines.commitment_id,
                    sum(commitment_lines.amount) AS total,
                    count(*) AS n,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE commitment_lines.is_estimate) AS estimates
                   FROM commitment_lines
                  GROUP BY commitment_lines.commitment_id) l ON l.commitment_id = c.id) v
     LEFT JOIN commitments p ON p.id = v.commitment_id;

name: commitments_outstanding
definition:
SELECT office_id,
    category,
    count(*) AS commitments,
    sum(amount_aed) AS amount_aed,
    min(quoted_on) AS oldest_quote,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'accepted'::commitment_status) AS accepted
   FROM commitments
  WHERE status = ANY (ARRAY['quoted'::commitment_status, 'accepted'::commitment_status])
  GROUP BY office_id, category;

name: document_watch
definition:
SELECT d.id,
    d.product_id,
    p.name AS product_name,
    d.doc_type,
    d.title,
    d.expires_on,
    d.expires_on - CURRENT_DATE AS days_left,
        CASE
            WHEN d.expires_on < CURRENT_DATE THEN 'expired'::text
            WHEN d.expires_on < (CURRENT_DATE + 60) THEN 'expiring'::text
            ELSE 'valid'::text
        END AS state
   FROM product_documents d
     JOIN products p ON p.id = d.product_id
  WHERE d.expires_on IS NOT NULL;

name: invoice_totals
definition:
SELECT v.invoice_id,
    v.status,
    v.invoice_date,
    v.due_date,
    v.subtotal,
    v.vat,
    v.total,
    v.received,
    v.outstanding,
    p.office_id
   FROM ( SELECT t.invoice_id,
            t.status,
            t.invoice_date,
            t.due_date,
            t.subtotal,
            t.vat,
            t.subtotal + t.vat AS total,
            t.received,
            t.subtotal + t.vat - t.received AS outstanding
           FROM ( SELECT i.id AS invoice_id,
                    i.status,
                    i.invoice_date,
                    i.due_date,
                    COALESCE(l.sub, 0::numeric) AS subtotal,
                        CASE
                            WHEN i.vat_applies THEN round(COALESCE(l.sub, 0::numeric) * i.vat_rate, 2)
                            ELSE 0::numeric
                        END AS vat,
                    COALESCE(p_1.paid, 0::numeric) AS received
                   FROM invoices i
                     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT invoice_lines.invoice_id,
                            sum(COALESCE(invoice_lines.quantity, 0::numeric) * COALESCE(invoice_lines.rate, 0::numeric)) AS sub
                           FROM invoice_lines
                          GROUP BY invoice_lines.invoice_id) l ON l.invoice_id = i.id
                     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT invoice_payments.invoice_id,
                            sum(invoice_payments.amount) AS paid
                           FROM invoice_payments
                          GROUP BY invoice_payments.invoice_id) p_1 ON p_1.invoice_id = i.id) t) v
     LEFT JOIN invoices p ON p.id = v.invoice_id;

name: open_order_lines
definition:
SELECT v.line_id,
    v.po_id,
    v.reference,
    v.supplier,
    v.status,
    v.expected_on,
    v.product_id,
    v.product_name,
    v.description,
    v.unit,
    v.qty_ordered,
    v.qty_received,
    v.qty_outstanding,
    v.quotation_id,
    v.project_id,
    p.office_id
   FROM ( SELECT l.id AS line_id,
            l.po_id,
            p_1.reference,
            p_1.supplier,
            p_1.status,
            p_1.expected_on,
            l.product_id,
            pr.name AS product_name,
            l.description,
            l.unit,
            l.qty_ordered,
            l.qty_received,
            round(l.qty_ordered - l.qty_received, 3) AS qty_outstanding,
            p_1.quotation_id,
            p_1.project_id
           FROM purchase_order_lines l
             JOIN purchase_orders p_1 ON p_1.id = l.po_id
             LEFT JOIN products pr ON pr.id = l.product_id
          WHERE (p_1.status = ANY (ARRAY['sent'::po_status, 'confirmed'::po_status, 'part'::po_status])) AND (l.qty_ordered - l.qty_received) > 0.001) v
     LEFT JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.id = v.po_id;

name: partner_ledger
definition:
SELECT v.partner_id,
    v.name,
    v.ownership_pct,
    v.share_capital,
    v.funded,
    v.drawings,
    v.contributed,
    v.fair_share,
    v.balance,
    p.office_id
   FROM ( WITH pot AS (
                 SELECT (( SELECT COALESCE(sum(partners.share_capital), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
                           FROM partners
                          WHERE partners.is_active)) + (( SELECT COALESCE(sum(expenses.amount_aed), 0::numeric) AS "coalesce"
                           FROM expenses
                          WHERE expenses.paid_by_partner_id IS NOT NULL)) AS total
                ), funded AS (
                 SELECT expenses.paid_by_partner_id AS pid,
                    sum(expenses.amount_aed) AS amt
                   FROM expenses
                  WHERE expenses.paid_by_partner_id IS NOT NULL
                  GROUP BY expenses.paid_by_partner_id
                ), drawn AS (
                 SELECT payroll.partner_id AS pid,
                    sum(payroll.amount) AS amt
                   FROM payroll
                  WHERE payroll.kind = 'drawing'::pay_kind AND payroll.partner_id IS NOT NULL
                  GROUP BY payroll.partner_id
                )
         SELECT p_1.id AS partner_id,
            p_1.name,
            p_1.ownership_pct,
            p_1.share_capital,
            COALESCE(f.amt, 0::numeric) AS funded,
            COALESCE(d.amt, 0::numeric) AS drawings,
            p_1.share_capital + COALESCE(f.amt, 0::numeric) AS contributed,
            round(pot.total * p_1.ownership_pct / 100.0, 2) AS fair_share,
            round(p_1.share_capital + COALESCE(f.amt, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(d.amt, 0::numeric) - pot.total * p_1.ownership_pct / 100.0, 2) AS balance
           FROM partners p_1
             CROSS JOIN pot
             LEFT JOIN funded f ON f.pid = p_1.id
             LEFT JOIN drawn d ON d.pid = p_1.id
          WHERE p_1.is_active) v
     LEFT JOIN partners p ON p.id = v.partner_id;

name: product_transport_summary
definition:
SELECT p.id AS product_id,
    p.name,
    p.hs_code,
    count(t.id) AS classified_components,
    bool_or(t.un_number IS NOT NULL) AS is_dangerous,
    bool_or(t.marine_pollutant) AS marine_pollutant,
    string_agg(DISTINCT t.un_number, ', '::text ORDER BY t.un_number) AS un_numbers,
    string_agg(DISTINCT t.un_class, ', '::text ORDER BY t.un_class) AS un_classes,
    min(t.packing_group) AS worst_packing_group,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM product_documents d
          WHERE d.product_id = p.id AND (d.doc_type = ANY (ARRAY['sds'::text, 'msds'::text]))) AS sds_on_file
   FROM products p
     LEFT JOIN product_transport t ON t.product_id = p.id
  GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.hs_code;

name: project_actuals
definition:
SELECT v.project_id,
    v.name,
    v.status,
    v.contract_value,
    v.quoted_cost,
    v.costs_booked,
    v.shipment_cost,
    v.material_issued,
    v.labour_cost,
    v.actual_cost,
    v.actual_gross,
    v.actual_margin_pct,
    v.quoted_margin_pct,
    v.has_actuals,
    p.office_id
   FROM ( WITH exp AS (
                 SELECT expenses.project_id,
                    sum(expenses.amount_aed) AS amt,
                    sum(expenses.amount_aed) FILTER (WHERE expenses.category ~~* '%labour%'::text OR expenses.category ~~* '%subcontract%'::text) AS labour,
                    sum(expenses.amount_aed) FILTER (WHERE expenses.category ~~* '%shipping%'::text OR expenses.category ~~* '%freight%'::text) AS freight
                   FROM expenses
                  WHERE expenses.project_id IS NOT NULL AND expenses.kind = 'expense'::expense_kind
                  GROUP BY expenses.project_id
                ), shp AS (
                 SELECT s.project_id,
                    sum(t.landed_cost) AS amt
                   FROM shipments s
                     JOIN shipment_totals t ON t.shipment_id = s.id
                  WHERE s.project_id IS NOT NULL
                  GROUP BY s.project_id
                ), iss AS (
                 SELECT m.project_id,
                    sum(m.quantity * COALESCE(k.eur_per_unit, 0::numeric) * (1::numeric - COALESCE(c.disc, 0.70)) * COALESCE(c.fx, 4.27)) AS amt,
                    sum(m.quantity) AS qty
                   FROM stock_movements m
                     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT min(product_packs.eur_per_unit) AS eur_per_unit
                           FROM product_packs
                          WHERE product_packs.product_id = m.product_id AND NOT product_packs.is_poa) k ON true
                     CROSS JOIN ( SELECT max(settings.value::numeric) FILTER (WHERE settings.key = 'supply_discount'::text) AS disc,
                            max(settings.value::numeric) FILTER (WHERE settings.key = 'eur_aed_rate'::text) AS fx
                           FROM settings) c
                  WHERE m.project_id IS NOT NULL AND m.direction = 'out'::text
                  GROUP BY m.project_id
                )
         SELECT p_1.id AS project_id,
            p_1.name,
            p_1.status,
            nz.value AS contract_value,
            COALESCE(p_1.material_cost, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(p_1.freight_cost, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(p_1.duty_cost, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(p_1.other_cost, 0::numeric) AS quoted_cost,
            COALESCE(exp.amt, 0::numeric) AS costs_booked,
            COALESCE(shp.amt, 0::numeric) AS shipment_cost,
            COALESCE(iss.amt, 0::numeric) AS material_issued,
            COALESCE(exp.labour, 0::numeric) AS labour_cost,
            COALESCE(exp.amt, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(shp.amt, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(iss.amt, 0::numeric) AS actual_cost,
            nz.value - (COALESCE(exp.amt, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(shp.amt, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(iss.amt, 0::numeric)) AS actual_gross,
                CASE
                    WHEN nz.value > 0::numeric THEN round((nz.value - (COALESCE(exp.amt, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(shp.amt, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(iss.amt, 0::numeric))) / nz.value * 100::numeric, 1)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS actual_margin_pct,
                CASE
                    WHEN nz.value > 0::numeric THEN round((nz.value - (COALESCE(p_1.material_cost, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(p_1.freight_cost, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(p_1.duty_cost, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(p_1.other_cost, 0::numeric))) / nz.value * 100::numeric, 1)
                    ELSE NULL::numeric
                END AS quoted_margin_pct,
            (COALESCE(exp.amt, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(shp.amt, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(iss.amt, 0::numeric)) > 0::numeric AS has_actuals
           FROM projects p_1
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(p_1.value, 0::numeric) AS value) nz
             LEFT JOIN exp ON exp.project_id = p_1.id
             LEFT JOIN shp ON shp.project_id = p_1.id
             LEFT JOIN iss ON iss.project_id = p_1.id) v
     LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = v.project_id;

name: project_totals
definition:
SELECT v.project_id,
    v.milestone_total,
    v.invoiced,
    v.paid,
    v.outstanding,
    v.total_cost,
    v.gross_profit,
    p.office_id
   FROM ( SELECT p_1.id AS project_id,
            COALESCE(sum(m.amount), 0::numeric) AS milestone_total,
            COALESCE(sum(m.amount) FILTER (WHERE m.invoiced_on IS NOT NULL), 0::numeric) AS invoiced,
            COALESCE(sum(m.amount) FILTER (WHERE m.paid_on IS NOT NULL), 0::numeric) AS paid,
            COALESCE(sum(m.amount) FILTER (WHERE m.invoiced_on IS NOT NULL AND m.paid_on IS NULL), 0::numeric) AS outstanding,
            COALESCE(p_1.material_cost, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(p_1.freight_cost, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(p_1.duty_cost, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(p_1.other_cost, 0::numeric) AS total_cost,
            COALESCE(p_1.value, 0::numeric) - (COALESCE(p_1.material_cost, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(p_1.freight_cost, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(p_1.duty_cost, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(p_1.other_cost, 0::numeric)) AS gross_profit
           FROM projects p_1
             LEFT JOIN payment_milestones m ON m.project_id = p_1.id
          GROUP BY p_1.id) v
     LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = v.project_id;

name: purchase_order_totals
definition:
SELECT v.po_id,
    v.reference,
    v.supplier,
    v.status,
    v.ordered_on,
    v.expected_on,
    v.currency,
    v.quotation_id,
    v.project_id,
    v.shipment_id,
    v.line_count,
    v.value,
    v.value_aed,
    v.qty_ordered,
    v.qty_received,
    v.received_pct,
    v.fully_received,
    v.document_count,
    p.office_id
   FROM ( WITH l AS (
                 SELECT purchase_order_lines.po_id,
                    count(*) AS line_count,
                    sum(purchase_order_lines.line_total) AS value,
                    sum(purchase_order_lines.qty_ordered) AS qty_ordered,
                    sum(purchase_order_lines.qty_received) AS qty_received,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE purchase_order_lines.qty_received >= (purchase_order_lines.qty_ordered - 0.001) AND purchase_order_lines.qty_ordered > 0::numeric) AS lines_complete
                   FROM purchase_order_lines
                  GROUP BY purchase_order_lines.po_id
                )
         SELECT p_1.id AS po_id,
            p_1.reference,
            p_1.supplier,
            p_1.status,
            p_1.ordered_on,
            p_1.expected_on,
            p_1.currency,
            p_1.quotation_id,
            p_1.project_id,
            p_1.shipment_id,
            COALESCE(l.line_count, 0::bigint) AS line_count,
            COALESCE(l.value, 0::numeric) AS value,
            round(COALESCE(l.value, 0::numeric) * COALESCE(p_1.eur_aed_rate, 4.27), 2) AS value_aed,
            COALESCE(l.qty_ordered, 0::numeric) AS qty_ordered,
            COALESCE(l.qty_received, 0::numeric) AS qty_received,
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(l.qty_ordered, 0::numeric) = 0::numeric THEN 0::numeric
                    ELSE round(COALESCE(l.qty_received, 0::numeric) / l.qty_ordered * 100::numeric, 1)
                END AS received_pct,
            COALESCE(l.lines_complete, 0::bigint) = COALESCE(l.line_count, 0::bigint) AND COALESCE(l.line_count, 0::bigint) > 0 AS fully_received,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM po_documents d
                  WHERE d.po_id = p_1.id) AS document_count
           FROM purchase_orders p_1
             LEFT JOIN l ON l.po_id = p_1.id) v
     LEFT JOIN purchase_orders p ON p.id = v.po_id;

name: quotation_totals
definition:
SELECT v.quotation_id,
    v.subtotal,
    v.cost_total,
    v.gross_profit,
    p.office_id
   FROM ( SELECT q.id AS quotation_id,
            COALESCE(sum(l.quantity * l.sell_rate), 0::numeric) AS subtotal,
            COALESCE(sum(l.quantity * l.cost_rate), 0::numeric) AS cost_total,
            COALESCE(sum(l.quantity * l.sell_rate), 0::numeric) - COALESCE(sum(l.quantity * l.cost_rate), 0::numeric) AS gross_profit
           FROM quotations q
             LEFT JOIN quotation_sections s ON s.quotation_id = q.id
             LEFT JOIN quotation_lines l ON l.section_id = s.id AND l.is_spec_note = false
          GROUP BY q.id) v
     LEFT JOIN quotations p ON p.id = v.quotation_id;

name: requirement_watch
definition:
SELECT v.id,
    v.approval_id,
    v.approval_title,
    v.approval_status,
    v."position",
    v.title,
    v.provided,
    v.provided_on,
    v.reference,
    v.owed_by,
    v.expires_on,
    v.days_left,
    v.has_expired,
    v.expiring_soon,
    v.at_risk,
    p.office_id
   FROM ( SELECT r.id,
            r.approval_id,
            a.title AS approval_title,
            a.status AS approval_status,
            r."position",
            r.title,
            r.provided,
            r.provided_on,
            r.reference,
            r.owed_by,
            r.expires_on,
            r.expires_on - CURRENT_DATE AS days_left,
            r.expires_on IS NOT NULL AND r.expires_on < CURRENT_DATE AS has_expired,
            r.expires_on IS NOT NULL AND r.expires_on >= CURRENT_DATE AND r.expires_on <= (CURRENT_DATE + 30) AS expiring_soon,
            r.provided AND r.expires_on IS NOT NULL AND (a.status <> ALL (ARRAY['approved'::approval_status, 'rejected'::approval_status])) AND r.expires_on <= (CURRENT_DATE + 30) AS at_risk
           FROM approval_requirements r
             JOIN approvals a ON a.id = r.approval_id
          WHERE r.expires_on IS NOT NULL) v
     LEFT JOIN approvals p ON p.id = v.approval_id;

name: shipment_totals
definition:
SELECT v.shipment_id,
    v.goods_value_aed,
    v.shipping_cost,
    v.landed_cost,
    v.line_count,
    v.document_count,
    v.has_dangerous_goods,
    p.office_id
   FROM ( WITH ln AS (
                 SELECT shipment_lines.shipment_id,
                    sum(COALESCE(shipment_lines.value_eur, 0::numeric)) AS value_eur,
                    count(*) AS n
                   FROM shipment_lines
                  GROUP BY shipment_lines.shipment_id
                )
         SELECT s.id AS shipment_id,
            round(
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(ln.value_eur, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric THEN ln.value_eur
                    ELSE COALESCE(s.goods_value_eur, 0::numeric)
                END * COALESCE(s.eur_aed_rate, 4.27), 2) AS goods_value_aed,
            COALESCE(s.freight_cost, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(s.insurance_cost, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(s.duty_cost, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(s.clearance_cost, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(s.other_cost, 0::numeric) AS shipping_cost,
            round(
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(ln.value_eur, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric THEN ln.value_eur
                    ELSE COALESCE(s.goods_value_eur, 0::numeric)
                END * COALESCE(s.eur_aed_rate, 4.27), 2) + COALESCE(s.freight_cost, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(s.insurance_cost, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(s.duty_cost, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(s.clearance_cost, 0::numeric) + COALESCE(s.other_cost, 0::numeric) AS landed_cost,
            COALESCE(ln.n, 0::bigint) AS line_count,
            ( SELECT count(*) AS count
                   FROM shipment_documents d
                  WHERE d.shipment_id = s.id) AS document_count,
            ( SELECT bool_or(COALESCE(l.un_number, ''::text) <> ''::text) AS bool_or
                   FROM shipment_lines l
                  WHERE l.shipment_id = s.id) AS has_dangerous_goods
           FROM shipments s
             LEFT JOIN ln ON ln.shipment_id = s.id) v
     LEFT JOIN shipments p ON p.id = v.shipment_id;

name: stale_inquiries
definition:
SELECT v.id,
    v.client_id,
    v.project_name,
    v.location,
    v.product_scope,
    v.estimated_value,
    v.stage,
    v.last_contact_date,
    v.next_action,
    v.owner_id,
    v.lost_reason,
    v.created_at,
    v.client_name,
    v.days_quiet,
    p.office_id
   FROM ( SELECT i.id,
            i.client_id,
            i.project_name,
            i.location,
            i.product_scope,
            i.estimated_value,
            i.stage,
            i.last_contact_date,
            i.next_action,
            i.owner_id,
            i.lost_reason,
            i.created_at,
            c.name AS client_name,
            CURRENT_DATE - i.last_contact_date AS days_quiet
           FROM inquiries i
             JOIN clients c ON c.id = i.client_id
          WHERE (i.stage <> ALL (ARRAY['won'::inquiry_stage, 'lost'::inquiry_stage])) AND (i.last_contact_date IS NULL OR i.last_contact_date < (CURRENT_DATE - 14))) v
     LEFT JOIN inquiries p ON p.id = v.id;

name: stock_detail
definition:
SELECT v.stock_id,
    v.product_id,
    v.product_name,
    v.category,
    v.warehouse_id,
    v.warehouse_name,
    v.qty_on_hand,
    v.unit,
    v.reorder_level,
    v.dcd_approved,
    v.dcd_ref,
    v.product_dcd_expiry,
    v.dcd_certified,
    v.dcd_certificate_ref,
    v.warehouse_cert_expiry,
    v.needs_product_approval,
    v.product_approval_expired,
    v.needs_warehouse_certificate,
    v.warehouse_certificate_expired,
    v.blocked,
    v.block_reason,
    p.office_id
   FROM ( SELECT s.id AS stock_id,
            s.product_id,
            pr.name AS product_name,
            pr.category,
            s.warehouse_id,
            w.name AS warehouse_name,
            s.qty_on_hand,
            s.unit,
            s.reorder_level,
            pr.dcd_approved,
            pr.dcd_ref,
            pr.dcd_expiry AS product_dcd_expiry,
            w.dcd_certified,
            w.dcd_certificate_ref,
            w.dcd_expiry AS warehouse_cert_expiry,
            NOT pr.dcd_approved AS needs_product_approval,
            pr.dcd_approved AND pr.dcd_expiry IS NOT NULL AND pr.dcd_expiry < CURRENT_DATE AS product_approval_expired,
            NOT w.dcd_certified AS needs_warehouse_certificate,
            w.dcd_certified AND w.dcd_expiry IS NOT NULL AND w.dcd_expiry < CURRENT_DATE AS warehouse_certificate_expired,
            NOT pr.dcd_approved OR NOT w.dcd_certified OR pr.dcd_expiry IS NOT NULL AND pr.dcd_expiry < CURRENT_DATE OR w.dcd_expiry IS NOT NULL AND w.dcd_expiry < CURRENT_DATE AS blocked,
            NULLIF(concat_ws('. '::text,
                CASE
                    WHEN NOT pr.dcd_approved THEN 'Waiting on Civil Defence approval for '::text || pr.name
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN pr.dcd_approved AND pr.dcd_expiry IS NOT NULL AND pr.dcd_expiry < CURRENT_DATE THEN (('The approval for '::text || pr.name) || ' expired on '::text) || to_char(pr.dcd_expiry::timestamp with time zone, 'DD/MM/YYYY'::text)
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN NOT w.dcd_certified THEN w.name || ' has no Civil Defence certificate for storing materials'::text
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END,
                CASE
                    WHEN w.dcd_certified AND w.dcd_expiry IS NOT NULL AND w.dcd_expiry < CURRENT_DATE THEN (('The storage certificate for '::text || w.name) || ' expired on '::text) || to_char(w.dcd_expiry::timestamp with time zone, 'DD/MM/YYYY'::text)
                    ELSE NULL::text
                END), ''::text) AS block_reason
           FROM stock s
             JOIN products pr ON pr.id = s.product_id
             JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id
          WHERE s.qty_on_hand <> 0::numeric) v
     LEFT JOIN warehouses p ON p.id = v.warehouse_id;

name: stock_position
definition:
WITH oh AS (
         SELECT s.product_id,
            w.office_id,
            sum(s.qty_on_hand) AS qty,
            max(s.reorder_level) AS reorder,
            min(s.unit) AS unit
           FROM stock s
             JOIN warehouses w ON w.id = s.warehouse_id
          GROUP BY s.product_id, w.office_id
        ), bl AS (
         SELECT d.product_id,
            d.office_id,
            sum(GREATEST(d.qty_on_hand, 0::numeric)) AS qty
           FROM stock_detail d
          WHERE d.blocked
          GROUP BY d.product_id, d.office_id
        ), cm AS (
         SELECT pm.product_id,
            pj.office_id,
            sum(GREATEST(pm.qty_required - COALESCE(pm.qty_delivered, 0::numeric), 0::numeric)) AS qty
           FROM project_materials pm
             JOIN projects pj ON pj.id = pm.project_id
          WHERE (pj.status = ANY (ARRAY['upcoming'::project_status, 'in_progress'::project_status])) AND pm.product_id IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY pm.product_id, pj.office_id
        ), keys AS (
         SELECT oh_1.product_id,
            oh_1.office_id
           FROM oh oh_1
        UNION
         SELECT cm_1.product_id,
            cm_1.office_id
           FROM cm cm_1
        )
 SELECT pr.id AS product_id,
    pr.name AS product_name,
    pr.category,
    COALESCE(oh.qty, 0::numeric) AS on_hand,
    COALESCE(oh.reorder, 0::numeric) AS reorder_level,
    COALESCE(cm.qty, 0::numeric) AS committed,
    COALESCE(oh.qty, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(cm.qty, 0::numeric) AS available,
    COALESCE(oh.unit, 'kg'::text) AS unit,
    COALESCE(bl.qty, 0::numeric) AS blocked,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(oh.qty, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(bl.qty, 0::numeric), 0::numeric) AS free_to_move,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(oh.qty, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(bl.qty, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(cm.qty, 0::numeric), 0::numeric) AS movable,
    ( SELECT d.block_reason
           FROM stock_detail d
          WHERE d.product_id = pr.id AND d.office_id = k.office_id AND d.blocked AND d.block_reason IS NOT NULL
         LIMIT 1) AS block_reason,
    k.office_id
   FROM keys k
     JOIN products pr ON pr.id = k.product_id
     LEFT JOIN oh ON oh.product_id = k.product_id AND oh.office_id = k.office_id
     LEFT JOIN bl ON bl.product_id = k.product_id AND bl.office_id = k.office_id
     LEFT JOIN cm ON cm.product_id = k.product_id AND cm.office_id = k.office_id
  WHERE COALESCE(oh.qty, 0::numeric) <> 0::numeric OR COALESCE(cm.qty, 0::numeric) <> 0::numeric OR COALESCE(oh.reorder, 0::numeric) > 0::numeric;

name: visit_funnel
definition:
SELECT v.client_id,
    v.name,
    v.kind,
    v.contact_person,
    v.phone,
    v.email,
    v.location,
    v.visits,
    v.first_visit,
    v.last_visit,
    v.days_since_visit,
    v.next_due,
    v.flagged_high,
    v.quotations,
    v.accepted_quotations,
    v.open_inquiries,
    v.jobs,
    v.job_value,
    v.stage,
    v.follow_up_overdue,
    v.going_cold,
    p.office_id
   FROM ( WITH v AS (
                 SELECT field_visits.client_id,
                    count(*) AS visits,
                    min(field_visits.visit_date) AS first_visit,
                    max(field_visits.visit_date) AS last_visit,
                    max(field_visits.priority) FILTER (WHERE field_visits.priority = 'high'::text) AS any_high,
                    min(field_visits.next_action_by) FILTER (WHERE field_visits.next_action_by IS NOT NULL) AS next_due
                   FROM field_visits
                  GROUP BY field_visits.client_id
                ), q AS (
                 SELECT quotations.client_id,
                    count(*) AS quotes,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE quotations.status = 'approved'::quotation_status) AS accepted,
                    max(quotations.created_at) AS last_quote_at
                   FROM quotations
                  WHERE quotations.client_id IS NOT NULL
                  GROUP BY quotations.client_id
                ), i AS (
                 SELECT inquiries.client_id,
                    count(*) FILTER (WHERE inquiries.stage <> ALL (ARRAY['won'::inquiry_stage, 'lost'::inquiry_stage])) AS open_inquiries
                   FROM inquiries
                  GROUP BY inquiries.client_id
                ), p AS (
                 SELECT projects.client_id,
                    count(*) AS jobs,
                    COALESCE(sum(projects.value), 0::numeric) AS job_value
                   FROM projects
                  WHERE projects.client_id IS NOT NULL
                  GROUP BY projects.client_id
                )
         SELECT c.id AS client_id,
            c.name,
            c.kind,
            c.contact_person,
            c.phone,
            c.email,
            c.location,
            COALESCE(v_1.visits, 0::bigint) AS visits,
            v_1.first_visit,
            v_1.last_visit,
            CURRENT_DATE - v_1.last_visit AS days_since_visit,
            v_1.next_due,
            v_1.any_high IS NOT NULL AS flagged_high,
            COALESCE(q.quotes, 0::bigint) AS quotations,
            COALESCE(q.accepted, 0::bigint) AS accepted_quotations,
            COALESCE(i.open_inquiries, 0::bigint) AS open_inquiries,
            COALESCE(p_1.jobs, 0::bigint) AS jobs,
            COALESCE(p_1.job_value, 0::numeric) AS job_value,
                CASE
                    WHEN COALESCE(p_1.jobs, 0::bigint) > 0 OR COALESCE(q.accepted, 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 'won'::text
                    WHEN COALESCE(q.quotes, 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 'quoted'::text
                    WHEN COALESCE(i.open_inquiries, 0::bigint) > 0 THEN 'in play'::text
                    ELSE 'visited'::text
                END AS stage,
            v_1.next_due IS NOT NULL AND v_1.next_due < CURRENT_DATE AND COALESCE(q.quotes, 0::bigint) = 0 AS follow_up_overdue,
            COALESCE(q.quotes, 0::bigint) = 0 AND COALESCE(i.open_inquiries, 0::bigint) = 0 AND (CURRENT_DATE - v_1.last_visit) > 21 AS going_cold
           FROM clients c
             JOIN v v_1 ON v_1.client_id = c.id
             LEFT JOIN q ON q.client_id = c.id
             LEFT JOIN i ON i.client_id = c.id
             LEFT JOIN p p_1 ON p_1.client_id = c.id) v
     LEFT JOIN clients p ON p.id = v.client_id;

name: visit_log
definition:
SELECT v.id,
    v.client_id,
    v.client_name,
    v.kind,
    v.visit_date,
    v.visited_by,
    v.contact_person,
    v.summary,
    v.product_interest,
    v.assessment,
    v.next_action,
    v.next_action_by,
    v.priority,
    p.office_id
   FROM ( SELECT v_1.id,
            v_1.client_id,
            c.name AS client_name,
            c.kind,
            v_1.visit_date,
            v_1.visited_by,
            v_1.contact_person,
            v_1.summary,
            v_1.product_interest,
            v_1.assessment,
            v_1.next_action,
            v_1.next_action_by,
            v_1.priority
           FROM field_visits v_1
             JOIN clients c ON c.id = v_1.client_id) v
     LEFT JOIN clients p ON p.id = v.client_id;

name: visit_scoreboard
definition:
SELECT office_id,
    count(*) AS companies_seen,
    sum(visits) AS visits_made,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE stage <> 'visited'::text) AS progressed,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE stage = ANY (ARRAY['quoted'::text, 'won'::text])) AS quoted,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE stage = 'won'::text) AS won,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE follow_up_overdue) AS overdue,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE going_cold) AS going_cold,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE flagged_high AND stage = 'visited'::text) AS high_and_untouched,
        CASE
            WHEN count(*) > 0 THEN round(count(*) FILTER (WHERE stage = ANY (ARRAY['quoted'::text, 'won'::text]))::numeric / count(*)::numeric * 100::numeric, 1)
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS quote_rate_pct,
    min(first_visit) AS since,
    max(last_visit) AS latest
   FROM visit_funnel
  GROUP BY office_id;
